reverie.title: REVERIE — loom work, afternoon light
narr: You both bent over the loom in that shed where the sun
fell warm through the gaps. Her hands moved the shuttle
while you set the tension. She said: 'Every thread holds
every other thread.' You understood it then—the archive
was just a loom. The mesh was just threads learning not
